operations.name: GetMyAccount
operations.summary: The signed-in person's own account.

operations.name: ListAccounts
operations.summary: Page through accounts, optionally by status. Administrators only.

operations.name: GetProject
operations.summary: One project with its places and contracts.

operations.name: GetTender
operations.summary: One tender with every bid, cheapest first, including those that lost.

operations.name: ListFacilities
operations.summary: A country's public facilities, optionally of one class.

operations.name: ListPlaceProjects
operations.summary: The projects that touch a place.

operations.name: ListTenders
operations.summary: A country's tenders, newest first, optionally by status.

operations.name: ListPosts
operations.summary: Contributions about a named thing, newest first. The implementation returns published posts only.

operations.name: RecordView
operations.summary: A named thing or article was viewed; one view per visitor per day.

operations.name: GetElection
operations.summary: One election with its contests and candidates.

operations.name: ListElections
operations.summary: A country's elections, newest first.

operations.name: ListTallies
operations.summary: The results to show for a place, per contest and option, chosen by the country's priorities.

operations.name: ListOccurrences
operations.summary: A country's civic calendar from a date: holidays, sittings, deadlines and polling days.

operations.name: ListAppropriations
operations.summary: The lines of one budget revision, in code order (the tree is given by parent ids).

operations.name: ListBudgets
operations.summary: A government's budgets by fiscal period, each with its revisions.

operations.name: ListFindings
operations.summary: Audit findings about an institution.

operations.name: GetCopyBundle
operations.summary: The interface messages of an app in the reader's language, falling back per key to English.

operations.name: GetHomeScreen
operations.summary: The home screen: served countries and the languages offered, localized.

operations.name: GetInstitutionScreen
operations.summary: An institution page: its name, arm and offices with their current holders.

operations.name: GetPlaceScreen
operations.summary: Everything a place page shows in one call: name, breadcrumb, divisions, headline figures, leaders, projects, upcoming events and articles. Without a place, the country itself.

operations.name: GetRankingScreen
operations.summary: One indicator across the places of a country, ranked, for one year (latest when omitted).

operations.name: SearchScreen
operations.summary: Named things whose names start with the text, localized and told apart by their parent place.

operations.name: FindPlacesAtPoint
operations.summary: The places whose subdivided pieces contain a point ("where am I?"), smallest first.

operations.name: GetOutline
operations.summary: The prepared outline of a place for one zoom band, with its bounding box and centre.

operations.name: GetPlace
operations.summary: One place by code with its dated parent links in every hierarchy.

operations.name: ListChildOutlines
operations.summary: Prepared outlines of the places inside a place, for drawing a map of its divisions.

operations.name: ListChildren
operations.summary: The current places directly inside a place, optionally in one hierarchy and at one level.

operations.name: ListPlaces
operations.summary: Places with all their names, optionally of one kind or by code prefix.

operations.name: GetInstitution
operations.summary: One institution with its offices and their holders: the leadership tree.

operations.name: GetOffice
operations.summary: One office with every holder and the steps that put each in office.

operations.name: ListInstitutions
operations.summary: A country's public institutions, optionally of one arm.

operations.name: ListMembers
operations.summary: What sits under or reports to an institution, position or office (part of, oversees, accountable to).

operations.name: ListPlaceOffices
operations.summary: The current offices for a place (governor, MCAs) with who holds them.

operations.name: ListPowers
operations.summary: The powers a position or institution holds over others (appoint, dismiss, veto, approve).

operations.name: ListEras
operations.summary: A country's named eras in time order.

operations.name: ListHistory
operations.summary: A country's historical occurrences in time order.

operations.name: GetIdentity
operations.summary: One named thing by code, with all its names and public identifiers.

operations.name: ResolveAddress
operations.summary: The named things a readable address segment opens in a country, current addresses first.

operations.name: SearchNames
operations.summary: Named things whose names start with the text, in any language.

operations.name: GetInstrument
operations.summary: One instrument with its editions.

operations.name: ListEffects
operations.summary: What law does to a named thing: the provisions that establish, govern or limit it.

operations.name: ListInstruments
operations.summary: Legal instruments, newest first, optionally of one kind.

operations.name: ListProvisions
operations.summary: The provision tree of an instrument with every official wording.

operations.name: GetBill
operations.summary: One bill with its stages, each dated through its sitting's calendar occurrence.

operations.name: ListBills
operations.summary: The bills of a house, optionally by status, newest first.

operations.name: ListVotes
operations.summary: How each member voted on a motion, with the party they voted as.

operations.name: GetArticle
operations.summary: One article with its texts in every language; machine translations are marked by origin.

operations.name: ListArticles
operations.summary: The articles for a named thing, newest first, with their titles in every language.

operations.name: ListAssets
operations.summary: The photos, logos, flags and videos that illustrate a named thing, with captions.

operations.name: GetParty
operations.summary: One party with the coalitions it has belonged to.

operations.name: ListCommitments
operations.summary: The commitments a person, party or office made, in their original words, with fulfilments.

operations.name: ListParties
operations.summary: A country's political parties.

operations.name: GetSite
operations.summary: The site served on a host, with its app, country and default locale.

operations.name: ListMessages
operations.summary: The interface messages of an app in one language; missing keys are gaps the UI shows as keys.

operations.name: ListReleases
operations.summary: Which countries are served on which app, and since when.

operations.name: GetCountry
operations.summary: One country by code, with its locales in fallback order.

operations.name: ListCountries
operations.summary: Countries with their ISO codes, calling code, currency and all names.

operations.name: ListCurrencies
operations.summary: Currencies with their ISO codes and minor units.

operations.name: ListHierarchies
operations.summary: How one country divides itself: its hierarchies over time, each with its levels in depth order.

operations.name: ListLanguages
operations.summary: Languages with their ISO codes, direction and names.

operations.name: ListUnits
operations.summary: Units of measurement with their symbols and conversions.

operations.name: ListEvidence
operations.summary: Where one row came from: each citation with its artifact, edition, product and publisher.

operations.name: ListSources
operations.summary: The publication channels Mzizi reads, with their publishers.

operations.name: GetIndicator
operations.summary: One indicator with the breakdowns it allows.

operations.name: ListIndicatorFigures
operations.summary: The figures of one indicator for every place of a country, for maps and rankings.

operations.name: ListIndicators
operations.summary: Indicators with unit, decimals, frequency and names, optionally of one topic.

operations.name: ListObservations
operations.summary: Every published observation behind a place's figures: other sources and revision history.

operations.name: ListPlaceFigures
operations.summary: The figures to show for one place, optionally of one indicator, newest period first.

operations.name: GetScheme
operations.summary: One scheme by code with its labels.

operations.name: ListTerms
operations.summary: The terms of a scheme in display order, with display hints, bands and all labels.
